headline: Top 100 Managers Best XI (GW 5): This is what's currently winning.
body: They have put together a decent 61-point week, once again well above the average points and above my measly 39 points, thanks to my horrific midfield performance led by Bruno and Rogers. Although things are early and the consensus is not strong, Calafiori, J. Pedro, and Groß were among the most popular picks, owned by 70, 66, and 67 of the top 100 managers, respectively. Haaland was also a clear favorite, appearing in 87 teams, but the midfield is still not agreed upon, as three of the picks out of 4 were in the red. Which doesn't help me that much, as that's the area I am weak at, but at least one pick is becoming glaringly obvious, but I am not sure if the performance is sustainable. https://preview.redd.it/q4ydxx9nyluh1.png?width=1913&format=png&auto=webp&s=1b6637718c6f00373191f0bf3e0228a2bd9ed12b And a very interesting thing you learn from the top is the bench is very prioritized, and managers plan their benches carefully as well, and they rotate a lot. Which is a complete opposite to how I used to do it, as I just tried to choose the best players for the starting lineup and get the cheapest for the bench, which is a horrific strategy, which I need to improve on, but it's so hard to plan like that and takes time, but I have added some strategy to it and just choose Hull City players that were cheap and guessed they can be a wild card, which was correct, but I think they may not be performing anymore and just need to pick better. If you want to dig deeper into ownership percentages and the teams of the top 100 FPL managers, go to my profile.   submitted by   /u/Molasses_Ambitious [link]   [comments]
